settings.label: One base color and one accent.
Towel, brush, and marker as the clean core.

settings.title: Start with what gets used.
settings.text: The towel is the most visible everyday piece. Match it first and the bag immediately feels more intentional.

settings.title: Keep the useful piece reachable.
settings.text: A clean bag is not just visual. It should make club care easier before the next shot.

settings.title: Repeat the accent in small details.
settings.text: A matching marker or divot tool gives the setup a finished signal without adding clutter.

settings.title: Pick the base
settings.text: Use the bag color you already carry as the anchor.

settings.title: Choose one accent
settings.text: Keep the towel, marker, and visible trim in the same color family.

settings.title: Stop before it gets busy
settings.text: Clean works because it is restrained. Add more only if the setup needs it.

settings.heading: The cleanest first upgrade.
settings.subheading: A minimal matching setup for golfers who want the bag sharper, easier to reset, and free from random accessories.
